sisi.depan: At the far end of the corridor, a massive door made of dark, polished wood with inlaid gold trim is marked with a large, glowing Galians crest that serves as the lock.
sisi.kanan: A continuous series of holding cells is set into the smooth grey wall, each opening sealed by a shimmering field of vertical blue energy bars.
sisi.belakang: Behind the viewpoint is a wide, unadorned archway of polished grey stone leading back into the main academy complex.
sisi.kiri: The left wall is a mirror of the right, featuring an identical row of cells secured by grids of glowing blue energy.

tengah: The polished dark floor is completely bare, reflecting the blue glow from the cells.
atas: The ceiling is a sequence of overlapping, dark grey metal panels in a tiered structure like an inverted joglo frame, with strips of cool white light recessed along the edges of each tier.
